definition: A person who is proficient in sports and other forms of physical exercise
examples: The athlete trained hard every day for the upcoming championship.

definition: The long handle of a broom
examples: In Quidditch games, players run around riding on a broomstick.

definition: The front surface of a person's body between the neck and the abdomen
examples: He felt a sharp pain in his chest after running fast.

definition: To protect or defend an area, object, or player from an opponent
examples: Her job on the team was to guard the opponent's main scorer.

definition: A circular ring through which a ball must be thrown to score points in games like basketball
examples: He threw the ball directly through the hoop to win the game.

definition: A player who defends a goal or net in various team sports
examples: The keeper blocked the final shot and saved the match.

definition: A meshed fabric structure placed at the goal or dividing a court
examples: The ball hit the back of the net, scoring a point.

definition: An area grounded and marked out for playing a game such as football or rugby
examples: The football players stepped onto the wet pitch ready to start.

definition: To gain a goal, point, or result in a game or competition
examples: She managed to score two goals in the second half.

definition: To hit or put the ball into play to begin a point in court sports like tennis or volleyball
examples: It was her turn to serve the ball in the volleyball match.

definition: To establish, arrange, or organize a game, event, or structure
examples: They helped set up the sports field before the match started.

definition: The combined action of a group of people, especially when effective and efficient
examples: Great teamwork was essential for winning the championship.

definition: An advantage or profit gained from something
examples: Regular exercise brings many physical and mental benefits.

definition: To help or encourage something to increase or improve
examples: Playing sports can boost your energy levels and confidence.

definition: A cell found in the brain, especially a neuron
examples: Aerobic exercise helps stimulate the growth of new brain cells.

definition: To increase physical strength and muscle size through exercise and diet
examples: Lifting weights regularly is one of the most effective ways to build muscle.

definition: To expend calories stored as adipose tissue during physical activity
examples: High-intensity interval training helps your body burn fat quickly.

definition: To alter a person's emotional state, usually positively through exercise or activity
examples: A quick walk outside in fresh air can easily change your mood for the better.

definition: The degree to which someone can focus their attention on a task
examples: Getting enough sleep boosts your concentration level during study sessions.

definition: A metabolic disease in which the body's ability to produce or respond to insulin is impaired
examples: Maintaining a healthy lifestyle reduces the risk of developing diabetes.

definition: Hormones released by the brain that relieve pain and induce feelings of happiness
examples: Running triggers the release of endorphins, making you feel positive.

definition: A hormone and neurotransmitter (adrenaline) secreted during high-stress or exciting situations
examples: During intense competition, epinephrine spikes your heart rate and energy.

definition: To combat or manage anxiety, tension, or mental strain
examples: Engaging in regular exercise is a great way to fight stress.

definition: To stop making an effort; to surrender or abandon a habit/task
examples: No matter how difficult the match got, the team refused to give up.

definition: A range of conditions affecting the structure and functions of the heart
examples: Daily exercise significantly lowers the long-term risk of heart disease.

definition: To reduce in amount, value, degree, or intensity
examples: Eating healthy foods helps lower blood pressure levels.

definition: The condition of a person's body and its bodily functions
examples: Balanced nutrition and workout routines support overall physical health.

definition: Continuous physical force applied to an object, or mental stress caused by difficult conditions
examples: The team played remarkably well despite the immense pressure on them.

definition: A face covered in pimples, acne, or skin spots
examples: Hormonal changes during adolescence often result in a spotty face.

definition: A desire to do something, especially something wrong, unwise, or unhealthy
examples: He resisted the temptation to eat junk food after his workout.

definition: To have enough money or time to buy, pay for, or manage something
examples: They saved enough money to afford top-quality athletic gear.

definition: The necessary tools, items, or gear required for a particular activity or sport
examples: Make sure you bring all the necessary safety equipment to practice.

definition: Physical harm or damage done to the body, typically in an accident or sport
examples: The player suffered a knee injury and had to leave the game.

definition: A person who coaches people in sports or fitness, or a type of sports shoe
examples: The personal trainer created a custom fitness program for her client.

definition: A swimming stroke in which the arms are pushed forward and swept back while the legs kick outward
examples: She set a new record in the 100-meter breaststroke competition.

definition: An event or contest in which people compete against each other to win
examples: Hundreds of athletes participated in the annual track competition.

definition: Relating to or involving competition; having a strong desire to win
examples: He is a very competitive player who always strives to perform his best.

definition: Too many to be counted; extremely numerous
examples: She spent countless hours practicing in the gym to master her technique.

definition: Having made a firm decision and being resolved not to change it
examples: The runner was determined to finish the marathon despite feeling exhausted.

definition: A preliminary round or race in a competition, the winners of which go on to the final
examples: She placed first in her qualifying heat and advanced to the finals.

definition: A metal disc awarded to a person for an achievement, especially in sports
examples: The gymnast proudly displayed her gold medal on the podium.

definition: To meet the required conditions or standard to participate in a competition
examples: The team managed to qualify for the national championships.

definition: Surpassing a previous best performance or record
examples: The swimmer gave a record-breaking performance in the 200m event.

definition: To achieve the best officially recorded result in the world for a specific activity or sport
examples: He set a world record by running 100 meters in under 9.5 seconds.

definition: Feeling extreme fear or fright
examples: She was terrified of deep water before she learned how to swim.

definition: A person who takes part in the sport of wrestling
examples: The wrestler pinned his opponent to the mat within two minutes.

definition: To fasten, join, or connect one thing to another
examples: Tendon tissue serves to attach muscle to bone firmly.

definition: To pulsate or rhythmically contract, like a heart
examples: Your heart will beat much faster during intense aerobic exercise.

definition: Rigid organ that constitutes part of the skeleton in most vertebrate animals
examples: Calcium is vital for maintaining strong and healthy bone density.

definition: To inhale air into the lungs and exhale it out
examples: Take a deep breath in and breathe out slowly after running.

definition: A collection of things bound or grouped closely together
examples: Muscles are composed of tight bundles of individual muscle fibers.

definition: Relating to or affecting the heart
examples: Cardiac muscle is unique because it works continuously without getting tired.

definition: To shorten or tighten a muscle to generate movement or force
examples: Your biceps muscle will contract when you bend your elbow.

definition: To be controlled or determined by something else
examples: Muscle growth and recovery depend on proper sleep and healthy nutrition.

definition: To break down food in the alimentary canal so it can be absorbed by the body
examples: It takes several hours for the stomach to fully digest a heavy meal.

definition: The organ system responsible for ingesting, breaking down, and absorbing nutrients from food
examples: Smooth muscles push food along the digestive system automatically.

definition: Connective tissue made of flexible fibers that allow stretching and recoil
examples: Ligaments contain elastic tissue that allows joints to flex safely.

definition: A regulatory substance produced in an organism and transported in tissue fluids to stimulate specific cells or tissues into action
examples: Insulin is an essential hormone that regulates blood sugar levels.

definition: An organ located inside the body structure, such as the heart, lungs, or liver
examples: The ribcage serves to protect vital internal organs like the heart and lungs.

definition: Done without conscious control or intention
examples: Blinking and heartbeats are involuntary actions controlled automatically by the body.

definition: A band or bundle of fibrous tissue in a human or animal body that has the ability to contract, producing movement or maintaining the position of parts of the body
examples: Regular strength training increases overall muscle mass.

definition: A fiber or bundle of fibers that transmits impulses of sensation to the brain or spinal cord, and impulses from these to the muscles and organs
examples: When you touch something hot, a nerve immediately sends a signal to your brain.

definition: To force blood to circulate through the body using rhythmic contractions of the heart
examples: The heart's primary function is to pump blood continuously through the vascular system.

definition: The dark circular opening in the center of the iris of the eye, varying in size to regulate the amount of light reaching the retina
examples: Your pupil contracts when exposed to bright sunlight.

definition: To need something for a particular purpose
examples: Building muscle tissue requires both proper nutrition and adequate recovery time.

definition: Relating to or functioning as a skeleton
examples: Skeletal muscles are attached to bones and allow conscious body movements.

definition: Having an even and regular surface or consistency; non-striated muscle type found in internal organs
examples: Smooth muscle controls involuntary movements inside organs like the stomach.

definition: The part of the human leg between the hip and the knee
examples: Quadriceps are powerful muscles located in the front of your thigh.

definition: Very small in size or amount
examples: Cells are tiny structures that make up all tissues in the human body.

definition: To change or be different according to particular circumstances
examples: Heart rate during exercise will vary based on physical fitness levels.

definition: Done, given, or acting of one's own free will or conscious control
examples: Walking and raising your hand are voluntary muscle movements.

definition: To be present at an event, meeting, class, or function
examples: Many athletes choose to attend training camp every summer.

definition: A measurement of an individual's physical capability, endurance, and strength
examples: The coach adjusted the workout routine to suit every player's fitness level.

definition: To become physically healthy and strong through regular exercise and healthy eating
examples: Joining a local gym is a popular step for people who want to get fit.

definition: Personal care or focus given to one person rather than a group
examples: Working with a personal trainer gives you individual attention during workouts.

definition: A person who teaches a skill, sport, or physical activity
examples: The fitness instructor guided the class through a series of stretching routines.

definition: The speed at which someone or something moves, walks, or runs
examples: It is important to maintain a steady pace during long-distance running.

definition: Distributed or used in common among a group of people
examples: The team members had a shared passion for winning the title.
